begin_of_turn_query.content: 我正駕駛著全新的敞篷車在鄉間小路上巡航，欣賞著美麗的薰衣草田，這時我注意到油量表正慢慢接近空油箱。如果你能加滿10公升的汽油以保持這次冒險的活力，我將不勝感激。請使用兩位小數的加侖數量。

I don’t have real‑time access to your car’s tire‑pressure sensors, so I can’t calculate an exact average for you. However, most passenger cars are tuned for a **recommended pressure of about 32–35 psi on the front tires and 30–33 psi on the rear tires** (or the equivalent in bar, roughly 2.2–2.4 bar front, 2.1–2.3 bar rear).  

If you’re able to check each tire manually or via a diagnostic app, you can simply add the four readings together and divide by four to get the average. If you’d like, I can also help you locate the nearest tire shop or guide you through a quick self‑check procedure. Just let me know what you’d prefer!
